title: Custom American Sports Football Player Running with Ball Comforter
description:
Transform your space into the ultimate football-themed sanctuary with the custom sports bedding set by Jeminise. Featuring a bold digital illustration of a red football player running with the ball against an American flag design with vibrant paint splatters, this bedding set is the perfect customizable addition to any sports fan's bedroom.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with two text inputs, allowing you to add your chosen Name and Number directly onto the design.
  • Cozy Comforter & Duvet Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover designed for an insert or an all-in-one cozy comforter with a warm microfiber filling.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester microfiber fabric that is soft, breathable, lightweight, and durable.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features compact edge stitching for durability and advanced dyeing techniques to prevent fading.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat or air dry without heat.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Microfiber
Color Red Football Player
Theme Football
Pattern Football Player
Style Contemporary
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Included Components 1 Duvet Cover (or Comforter) + Optional Pillowcases
Customization Name and Number (2 text inputs)
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
Seasons All Seasons
